Freedom fighters sing national anthem in 1971
2014-12-09T00:02:12+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/freedom-fighters-sing-national-anthem-in-1971-54503

Freedom fighters sing national anthem of Bangladesh in Gita Mehta's Dateline Bangladesh documentary. They (Mukti Bahini) took part in training and battle fields in the Liberation War in 1971. Mehta, a war correspondent of US TV network NBC was also on assignment in Bangladesh during the war, and with what she saw and captured, made the powerful documentary .The video was shared on YouTube by the channel of International Crimes Strategy Forum (ICSF) (URL: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vFHlPID-eSk).
